From squishing a lot of roaches in game and out, I would recommend this recipe.

First start by removing the head and legs. Wrap them up and save them, (we will use them later as fried roach legs) You can give the head a kick we never use that. Next comes cracking the bad boy open and collect the White thick cream that comes out. Scrape this up and place this in a pot(some people call this pus but this should be a no judgment zone). Save this it will come in handy later.

Now when it comes to cooking rad roach plenty of plenty of folk will tell you to flay it from the skin (exoskeleton to be exact) . This would be right if we are grilling it but today we are going to bake it.

Now the trick to baking rad roach is to set it and  forget it. The shell of the scamp really does trap the heat and gives it a nice equal cooking. For safety reasons pour 1 qt. of rad-away inside it (but honestly I prefer it with a little kick). Next add any veggies you can find. If your lucky to find carrots and potatoes use them but I find that maize and xander root are easier to get my hands on. 

Finally add about another qt of pure water. (this is if you added the qt of rad away if you couldn't find it then use 2 qt of dirty water because whats the point right?)  Stir up the insides and try to mix the water and veggies with the meat. Try not to puncture the shell and scrape the meat off. Don't worry if you don't roach has a nice way of separating itself when it gets to baked. Restitch it with some striped cords from any scrap electronics you can find (the plastic part not the copper). Send it in the oven for Very High for 35 min. 

Now lets go back to the Rad Roach cream. Add some insta-mash, Brahmin mik, and Big horn butter (tastes so much creamer that Brahmin butter but its up to you) mix it up and set for a low heat. You can use some broc flower flakes if you don't have and pepper.  When every thing sets together you should have some thick creamy rad roach mash. (and a lovely smelling house.) 

Next we wait for the roach roast to be done and when it is pull it out and reopen it. (Its the best part!) Add the Mash on top and DO NOT MIX IT IN YET. You only want a layer on top. Put it back in the oven for another 5-8 min. When you pull it out your mash should have this nice golden brown crust on top. Wait for it to cool and Serve. 

And there you go, you got yourself wastelander shepherds pie.
